pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

3. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.
   B. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.

4. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

5. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.

6. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

9. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

10. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

11. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Handball.
   B. Damage equipment used for Handball.
   C. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Handball.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Storytelling and Animation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Football and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. C — The speed of the music

3. B — Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. B — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. A — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. B — Red, blue, and yellow

7. C — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

9. C — Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. D — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. C — Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Storytelling and Animation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Football; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Songs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
